elements.text: Private businesses and individuals make many decisions about what goods to produce and what services to provide.
Individuals can start their own private businesses and hire workers.
Some products, such as medicine, must be approved by the government.

Private businesses and individuals own property and equipment. They hire workers to produce goods and services.
The government sets a minimum wage for all workers and requires private businesses to follow many health and safety rules.
The government often hires private companies to build and run public services, like schools.
Private businesses and individuals can sell goods and services where and how they choose.
Individuals can purchase goods and services based on what they can afford.

The government provides health care to everyone living in the United Kingdom.
